title: C#: Variables & Types
description: Write a C# program that declares variables with different types using implicit and explicit typing.
verificationTest: output.includes('Name: C#') && output.includes('Version: 12') && output.includes('Pi: 3.14159') && output.includes('Is fun: True') && output.includes('Implicitly typed!')
hints: Use explicit types: `int x = 5;` or `var x = 5;` for implicit typing
